fn heapsort<T: Ord>(a: &mut [T], lo: usize, hi: usize) {

    for i in (1..n).rev() {

        sift(a, lo, 0, i);
    }
}

fn sift<T: Ord>(a: &mut [T], lo: usize, s: usize, n: usize) {
    let mut i = s;
    loop {
        let l = 2 * i + 1;
        if l >= n { break; }
        let r = l + 1;

        if a[lo + i] >= a[lo + m] { break; }
        a.swap(lo + i, lo + m);
        i = m;
    }
}
